title: Cheap Looking
text: Cheap Looking. I usually love DII baskets, but these are just not the same. The outer marble fabric is nylon and it LOOKS like nylon. The black handles and inner lining is the paper fabric, not at all durable. The size of these is also a little off. The small ones are a good size, but the larger ones are just awkwardly sized. 2 of them fit in a standard cube storage spot. But they just don't utilize the space well. They are on the small side for "big baskets" but on the large side for "small baskets". They work, these just look a lot cheaper than other DII baskets.
